prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-19, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-02-19):
Price action as of 2026-02-19: 1w +4.5%, 1m +4.6%, 3m +17.0%. Last close 205.41. 21d annualized realized volatility 22%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 100% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock is exhibiting strong, consistent upward momentum across all major short-to-medium-term timeframes (1-week, 1-month, and 3-month periods) and has just closed at a 63-day high. Supported by a healthy 21-day annualized realized volatility of 22%, this trend indicates robust buying pressure and a high probability of continued upward continuation over the next 20 trading days. 

DECISION: BUY
